docs.doc: FR11: Users can select marble type from catalog with immediate texture change. FR17: 3D renders photo-realistic marble textures. NFR3: Changes reflect in 3D view within 500ms. NFR4: Price and weight calculations < 200ms.
Component pattern: Hooks first, derived state, event handlers, render. Use individual selectors for optimal re-renders. Store actions via getState() for SSR-safe calls.
Components at src/components/configurator/MarbleSelector.tsx. Stores at src/stores/configStore.ts. Constants at src/constants/marbles.ts.
MarbleSelector: Grid of marble swatches with preview. States: Default, Hover (show name), Selected (gold border). Accessibility: role="radiogroup" with labeled options.
Arrow keys navigate marble selector. Touch targets: 44×44px minimum on mobile. Screen readers: aria-label with marble name.
Accent color: Champagne Gold #C9A962 for selected states and CTAs. Focus ring: gold on dark theme.
Story definition with full acceptance criteria and technical notes. Pre-requisites: Story 3.2 (store), Story 3.3 (3D viewer), Story 2.1 (marble data).

SSR Hydration Pattern: Use individual selectors (useMarbleSlug) and getState() for actions. Focus Styling: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent. Touch Targets: Minimum 44×44px (size-11 in Tailwind).

constraints.constraint: Use individual Zustand selectors (useMarbleSlug) and getState() for actions to avoid SSR hydration mismatches. Never destructure the entire store.
Marble changes must reflect in 3D view within 500ms. Store update triggers immediate re-render via useConfigStore subscription.
Price and weight recalculations must complete in < 200ms. calculateDerivedValues is already optimized.
Use role="radiogroup" on container, role="radio" on swatches. Arrow key navigation. Visible focus ring. aria-label with marble name.
Minimum 44×44px (size-11 in Tailwind) for mobile touch accessibility per UX spec 8.1.
Follow architecture.md pattern: 1) Hooks first 2) Derived state 3) Event handlers 4) Render.
Use cn() from lib/utils for conditional Tailwind classes. Gold accent: #C9A962 (accent color in Tailwind config).
All user-facing text via useTranslations("configurator"). Marble names from multilingual JSON when available.

interface.name: useMarbleSlug
interface.description: Returns current marble slug from config store. Use for reading marble selection.

interface.name: setMarble
interface.description: Updates marble selection. Validates slug exists in MARBLE_DATA, triggers weight/price recalculation.

interface.name: useCalculatedValues
interface.description: Returns derived weight (kg) and price (cents). Recalculates when marble/dimensions/finish change.

interface.name: MARBLE_DATA
interface.description: Lookup map for all marble slugs. Keys are valid slugs for setMarble validation.

interface.name: MarbleSelectorProps
interface.description: Props for MarbleSelector component. className for styling override, disabled for readonly state.
